FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF MAHARAGAMA URBAN COUNCIL UNDERSECTION 66A(1) (a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member in Maharagama Urban Council has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation;

AND WHEREAS the Leader of Independent Group No. 02, to which Widanagamage Nisantha Kumara theMember appointed to Ward No. 18 Maharagama South of Maharagama Urban Council belonged, was required byme under Section 66 A (1) (a) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon the member of that Ward No.18,Maharagama South of Maharagama Urban Council who belongs to such Independent Group and is not disqualifiedunder Section 9 of the local authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared elected asa member within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Leader of aforesaid Independent Group No. 02, has communicated his decision tonominate Nuwan Madhushanka Fernando to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I. Sudu Dewage Shanika Anuruddha Rupasinghe, Returning Officer of MaharagamaUrban Council, acting in terms of Section 66A(1) (a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262)do hereby declare that Nuwan Madhushanka Fernando was slected as the member of the Ward No. 18, MaharagamaSouth of Maharagama Urban Council.
S. D. S. A. RUPASINGHE,Returning Officer,Maharagama Urban Council.
